name: ship
title: Ship
description: A big three-masted sailing ship you can board and walk through: a plank up from the dock, the waist, the quarterdeck with its wheel, the forecastle with its bell and bowsprit, a gun deck with a cannon at every port and hammocks slung forward, a cargo hold, and the captain's cabin under the stern windows. Lanterns light the decks below. Seeded planking, sails, gunport lids and cargo; moored and steady.
